lines.zh: 我用宽大的胸鳍贴着河底滑。
lines.en: I glide on broad fins along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我一扇一扇，像一片叶子。
lines.en: I flap like a leaf drifting.
My long tail trails behind me.
River sand lifts under me.
I drift upstream through the murk.
One ripple and the water parts.

lines.zh: 沙底的浅坑，是我压出来的。
lines.en: The shallow pits in the sand are mine.
I pass slowly over a sunken log.
I swim a stretch of the bend.
No hurry; the water carries me.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋在沙里一半。
lines.en: I bury myself half in sand.
I head for the shallows.

lines.zh: 我贴底不动，和沙一个色。
lines.en: I lie still, the color of sand.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑纹很像眼睛。
lines.en: The spots on me look like eyes.
My tail spine stands up; don't step.
I fan my pectoral fins slowly.
The cool of the bottom is pleasant.
I lie and watch the light above.

lines.zh: 一条鱼从我头边游过去了。
lines.en: A fish swam past my head.
Half-buried, I wait.

lines.zh: 我不怎么动，也不怎么饿。
lines.en: I seldom move, seldom hunger.
This stretch of bed is mine.
I lift my tail spine a little.
The water rocks me gently.

lines.zh: 远处一声落水，我抬起了尾刺。
lines.en: Something splashes far off; my tail barb lifts.
I move little, like a stone.

lines.zh: 你踩在水里，脚下很危险。
lines.en: You're standing in the water; it's dangerous underfoot.
I lift my eyes to your feet.

lines.zh: 我身上那些眼斑，会骗人。
lines.en: Those eyespots will fool you.

lines.zh: 我埋在河泥里，只剩眼睛。
lines.en: Buried in river mud, only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 我尾巴上的刺不是装饰。
lines.en: The spine on my tail isn't decoration.
I shift away so as not to startle you.

lines.zh: 你在我的河床上面站着。
lines.en: You're standing over my riverbed.

lines.zh: 水底的影子看着很大吧。
lines.en: My shadow below looks large, doesn't it.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，能看见你的脚踝。
lines.en: I raise my head and see your ankles.

lines.zh: 你再往前一步，就麻烦了。
lines.en: One step further and you're in trouble.

lines.zh: 我隔着沙看你，不动声色。
lines.en: I watch through the sand, quietly.

lines.zh: 我的形状贴在地上，很难发现。
lines.en: I lie flat, hard to notice.
You wave, and the ripples reach me.
I open my mouth, as if smiling.

lines.zh: 河底和海岸不一样，我不着急。
lines.en: The riverbed is not the sea; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我一直待在这里，很多年。
lines.en: I've stayed here many years.

lines.zh: 你走开时，我会跟着挪一点。
lines.en: When you walk away, I'll shift a little.
No need for a net; I won't swim off.
My pectoral fin is pinned.
Pain on the riverbed is a dull one.
I twist my body once.

lines.zh: 我尾刺差点弹出，硬忍住了。
lines.en: My tail barb almost fired—I held it back.

lines.zh: 我把身体往沙里埋深一寸。
lines.en: I sink an inch deeper into the sand.
My spots have contracted.
That stomp left my pectoral fin numb.

lines.zh: 水被搅起来，我看不清你。
lines.en: The water's clouded; I can't see you.
I can still swim along the bottom.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我可就不客气。
lines.en: One more and I won't be gentle.
I caught that faint smell.
I slowly lift my body.
It settled on the sand.
I press over it and cover it.

lines.zh: 我掀起一层沙，把它盖住。
lines.en: I lift a layer of sand and cover it.
Lower it a bit so I can take it.
What's in the sand, I can find.
This will last me a day.
I tuck it under my body.
Tastes good; do you have more?

lines.zh: 你踩上来，我像地毯一样软。
lines.en: You step on me and I'm soft as carpet.
Flat on the bed, I can't slip away.

lines.zh: 别推我，我的刺会扬起来。
lines.en: Don't shove; my spine will lift.
The sand by your feet gave way.

lines.zh: 我整片身体从你鞋底滑开。
lines.en: My whole body slides out from under your boot.
Underwater bumps make no sound.
You touched my edge.
I'm wide; go around.
The harder you tread, the deeper you sink.
I lie still against the bottom.
Another patterned shape approaches.
Our pectoral fins touch.

lines.zh: 河底的沙被我们一起翻动。
lines.en: We churn the riverbed sand together.
Its spots are denser than mine.
We settle together in a shallow pit.
This bed can raise our young.
The current brings us level.
Our tails trail side by side.
In this moment the sand is warm.
We'll stay together a long while.
I press it down and tuck it under.
What sinks here, I keep.
I fan it over with a fin.

lines.zh: 沙里的东西我都能找到。
lines.en: I can find anything in the sand.
It's hard; I'll wear it down.
I bury it in the sand.
I'll hold this in my mouth.
I can't bite well; I can only hold.
It's cold against my belly.
I slowly move it back into the pit.
That thing is moving on the sand.
I see it, right ahead.
I slowly raise my body.
My tail spine is already aimed.

lines.zh: 它就在我尾刺够得到的地方。
lines.en: It's right within reach of my barb.
This time I needn't chase.
I slide over along the bottom.
My tail barb hides under the sand.
That shadow on the sand is mine.
I hold still and let it come near.
I've readied this a long while.
It's right above my shallow pit.
The barb on my tail is venomous.
It looks down into the water; perfect.
What's on this bed is mine.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺，已经对着它了。
lines.en: My tail barb is already aimed at it.
I creep along the sand.
The ripples carry it toward me.
I'm guessing where it will land.

lines.zh: 我半埋在沙里，它还在走。
lines.en: Half-buried in sand, I watch it walk on.
I flatten myself further.
A little closer and my spine will reach.

lines.zh: 它每搅一下水，我就知道它在哪。
lines.en: Each stir tells me where it is.
I wait for it to step into the pit.

lines.zh: 河底的沙把我的形状藏住了。
lines.en: The sand hides my shape.
I slowly turn toward it.

lines.zh: 它站在我的地盘正中间。
lines.en: It stands right in the middle of my ground.
I lift my spine, gathering force.
The water's shallow; it can't run.
I still have plenty of time.
It has shifted that way.
Good, just like that.
I'm one tail-length away.
About right; that will do.
One tail swing and the spine rakes across.
My spine sinks into its hide.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺藏在沙里，抬起来就扎。
lines.en: My tail barb lifts out of the sand.
We churn the sand into murk.
It stepped on my back.

lines.zh: 我的身体一弹，把它掀开。
lines.en: One buck of my body throws it off.
That one was hard to see coming.
It cried out from the sting.
I settle back into the sand, still again.
This patch of bed is mine to guard.
Its feet sink into the sand.
I add another sting.
Blood spreads slowly in water.
It retreats; I wait.
I heave my whole body upward.
The spine tip slices its shin.

lines.zh: 我从河底的沙里抬起头。
lines.en: I lift out of the riverbed sand.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子动了一下。
lines.en: A shadow stirs beneath the surface.
The stingray glides in low.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹在水下若隐若现。
lines.en: My spots appear and fade underwater.
I fan a layer of sand aside.
I claim this stretch of the bend.
I slide out of my shallow pit.
Something in the water is watching you.
I pass beneath your feet.
You can't tell where I am, can you.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺先探进这片浅水。
lines.en: My tail barb enters the shallows first.
This sandy bottom is comfortable.
I fan slowly below the surface.

lines.zh: 河水清了一点，你能看见我了。
lines.en: The river clears a bit; now you see me.
I drifted down from upstream.
My eyespots seem to follow you.
Every fish here knows me.

lines.zh: 我扇着胸鳍，慢慢落到河底。
lines.en: I fan my pectoral fins and settle to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 热水浇下来，我的皮肤发紧。
lines.en: Hot water pours down and my skin tightens.
I'm lifted and thrown back to the river.

lines.zh: 我埋在沙里太久，吸不到水。
lines.en: Too long buried, and I can't draw water.
The blast turns the whole bed over.

lines.zh: 箭扎进背，我的斑纹缩紧了。
lines.en: The arrow hits my back and my spots contract.

lines.zh: 这股力钻进沙里，从我身上穿过去。
lines.en: The force runs through the sand and me.
Too long hungry, even my fins slow.

lines.zh: 雷顺着河水扫过来，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning sweeps the river and numbs me.
No water here, and no sand.
